## Checklist

- [ ] I linked to a primary source over an aggregator or referral URL.
- [ ] The description is factual, concise, and ends with a period.
- [ ] I placed the entry alphabetically in the most specific section.
- [ ] My pull request title starts with `add:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, or `chore:`.
- [ ] I disclosed any affiliation with the resource below.
- [ ] I ran `npm test`.
